eye: eye (maximum diameter perpendicular to the dorsoventral eye axis), adults
conditions: Table 1 of the paper (Materials and Methods, Sampling), 'Metadata of the study species' eye diameter, body length, and ecological classifications': all numeric data are mean values except n; eye diameter and body length in mm, depths and DVM distance in m. Specimens: 454 adult sergestid shrimps in total (49 from the Florida Straits expedition of 4–8 May 2019 on R/V Weatherbird II, 193 from a second northern Gulf of Mexico expedition, 213 from the Florida International Crustacean Collection), caught by 1- or 9-m2 tucker trawl by day and night; the collection specimens were preserved in about 70% ethanol prior to measurement (preservation of the expedition animals was not read). Eye diameter was measured with Mitutoyo CD-8 ASX Digimatic calipers at the maximum distance perpendicular to the dorsoventral eye axis. Sex not stated; no SD for eye diameter is shown in the table. Per-species n and the other species' means are in the same table (range of means 0.5 mm in Allosergestes pectinatus to 1.8 mm in Robustosergia robusta). Row also gives body length 20.0 mm and organ type 'Pesta'.
